output.plan: Averages the non-NULL grades of enrollments in offerings whose course title contains 'programming' and 'intro', taught by a teacher whose name contains 'Chen', in a semester with term starting 'winter' and year 2025. Results are grouped by offering so each matching class is listed with its teacher and semester; ungraded enrollments are ignored by AVG. Assumes 'Dr. Chen' matches any teacher named Chen and that the term is stored as 'Winter'.
output.sql: SELECT c.code, c.title, t.id AS teacher_id, t.name AS teacher_name, s.id AS semester_id, s.name AS semester_name, AVG(e.grade) AS average_grade FROM enrollments e JOIN course_offerings o ON e.offering_id = o.id JOIN courses c ON o.course_id = c.id JOIN teachers t ON o.teacher_id = t.id JOIN semesters s ON o.semester_id = s.id WHERE c.title LIKE '%programming%' AND c.title LIKE '%intro%' AND t.name LIKE '%Chen%' AND s.term LIKE 'winter%' AND s.year = 2025 GROUP BY c.id, c.code, c.title, t.id, t.name, s.id, s.name
